metadata.title: SI Units And Measurement
metadata.topic: Measurement language for smart pump systems

learningPurpose: Give students a focused, source-linked reference for pump-system quantities, SI units and measurement-context checks.

definitions.meaning: A named reading or signal that carries one stated measured quantity with a value, unit and context.
The location, instrument, operating condition and timestamp needed before a reading can be interpreted.

governingPrinciples: A measurement is not diagnosis until quantity, value, unit and context are known.
Industrial Learn calculation functions require explicit SI units internally.
Measurement location, instrument condition, operating state, and timing affect interpretation.
The reviewed sources do not establish pump diagnostic thresholds or equipment ratings for this lesson.

assumptions: The file covers measurement language only.
Any conversion from a non-SI unit must be explicit and source-reviewed.
Diagnostic rules require additional approved evidence.
limitations: Does not teach pump selection, cavitation, pump curves, predictive maintenance or AI diagnosis.
The DOE sourcebook is guidance rather than a current pump test standard.
No equipment-specific measurement range, alarm threshold, or live-work procedure is authorised.

workedExample.title: Check a measurement row
workedExample.purpose: Verify whether a reading is ready for calculation.
given: Unit and context must be explicit.
workedExample.answer: The reading is usable only when quantity, value, unit and context are explicit.

normalOperation: Measurement channels are interpreted only after unit and context are confirmed.
commonMisconceptions: Assuming a number without a unit is safe to calculate with.
Treating kW as interchangeable with kWh.
Treating L/s and L/min as equivalent without explicit conversion.

faultConditions.title: Ambiguous measurement unit
symptoms: A reading is present but its unit is missing or incompatible.
faultConditions.safeResponse: Do not use the reading for diagnosis until the unit and conversion evidence are confirmed.

safety.warning: A training measurement exercise does not authorise operation, adjustment or troubleshooting of real pump equipment.
safety.studentBoundary: Students must use approved simulated data unless an authorised instructor provides controlled access.
